jobs.title: Director, AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Technology Services

Technology Services (TS) is responsible for delivering all enterprise infrastructure, applications and related end user technology services across all Brookfield business groups.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Role Summary

Leads the design of enterprise AI solutions that align business priorities, data foundations, architecture standards, and platform capabilities. This role translates complex business needs into scalable, secure, and governed AI solution designs, including GenAI and agent-based use cases. Partners with business, product, data, engineering, security, and governance teams to move high-value AI solutions from concept to production.

Key Responsibilities

Assess business problems and define end-to-end AI solution architectures aligned to enterprise priorities
Translate product and business requirements into scalable, secure, and supportable AI designs
Define architecture patterns for AI, GenAI, retrieval-based, and agent-enabled solutions
Ensure solution designs are grounded in trusted data, integration, and platform architecture standards
Partner with product owners, data architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to shape implementation roadmaps
Guide technology selection, integration patterns, and design decisions across AI solution components
Establish non-functional requirements for security, governance, performance, resiliency, and supportability
Ensure AI solutions align with responsible AI, risk, compliance, and control requirements Review and govern solution designs through architecture checkpoints and design standards
Support pilots, production deployments, and architecture evolution based on business feedback and operational learnings

Required Experience

10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, data architecture, or AI-related roles
Proven experience designing and delivering complex enterprise technology solutions across multiple systems and stakeholders
Experience with AI, machine learning, GenAI, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments
Experience working with cloud platforms, enterprise data ecosystems, APIs, and integration patterns
Experience operating in regulated, security-conscious, or highly governed enterprise environments
Experience partnering with business leaders to translate strategic priorities into architecture designs

Skills & Qualifications

Technical knowledge and systems expertise: Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, AI and machine learning, GenAI, data platforms, integration patterns, and the data foundations required for scalable AI and agent-based solutions.
Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to assess complex business and technical challenges and translate them into scalable, practical, and governed solution designs.
Communication and collaboration capabilities: Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional influence skills.
Ability to work in cross-functional or global teams: Experience operating across global teams and aligning business, product, architecture, engineering, security, and governance stakeholders.
Understanding of technology governance, security, or operational practices: Strong understanding of responsible AI, risk management, security, compliance, and operational design requirements for enterprise AI solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services, asset management, or similarly complex industries
Experience designing AI solutions that support decision-making, workflow automation, or knowledge-based use cases
Familiarity with modern cloud-based data and AI platforms and MLOps or model operations practices
Experience with architecture governance, design review processes, or enterprise architecture frameworks
Exposure to retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge architectures, or agent orchestration patterns

Salary Range: $150,000 - $185,000 CAD

Position Opening Reason:

New Position

Brookfield is committed to maintaining a Positive Work Environment that is safe and respectful; our shared success depends on it. Accordingly, we do not tolerate workplace discrimination, violence or harassment.

Brookfield is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive organization. We are committed to providing barrier-free and accessible employment practices in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Should you require a Human Rights Code-protected accommodation through any stage of the recruitment process, please make them known when contacted and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Specialty Technology Solutions
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

McKesson is seeking a strategic and innovative Senior Director, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud & Patient Support Program Solutions to lead enterprise-scale transformation initiatives supporting patient services, commercial operations, and healthcare engagement programs. This leader will drive the vision, delivery, and optimization of Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud solutions while building scalable Patient Support Program (PSP) capabilities that enhance patient access, adherence, and outcomes.

The role combines executive leadership, service management, platform modernization, data migration strategy, and cross-functional business transformation to deliver measurable value across life sciences and healthcare ecosystems.

What You'll Do

Lead strategy, roadmap, and execution for Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and Patient Support Program solutions.
Drive enterprise service management practices to improve operational performance, customer experience, and business outcomes.
Establish scalable Patient Support Program capabilities supporting patient onboarding, adherence, access, affordability, and engagement.
Define and oversee enterprise data migration, data quality, governance, and integration strategies across CRM and healthcare platforms.
Partner with business, technology, compliance, and operations leaders to align platform investments with organizational priorities.
Lead large-scale digital transformation initiatives, including platform modernization, cloud adoption, automation, and process optimization.
Manage strategic vendor relationships, delivery partners, budgets, forecasts, and investment planning.
Build high-performing teams through talent development, succession planning, leadership coaching, and organizational excellence.

Basic Requirements

13+ years of professional experience, including 6+ years leading large technology, digital transformation, or healthcare solutions organizations.
Experience leading Salesforce platforms, including Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Service Cloud, or related CRM solutions.
Proven experience delivering Patient Support Program, Patient Services, Patient Engagement, or Specialty Pharmacy technology solutions.
Demonstrated leadership of enterprise-scale technology programs, transformation initiatives, and cross-functional teams.
Experience developing and executing data migration strategies, data governance frameworks, and enterprise integration initiatives.
Strong financial leadership experience managing budgets, forecasts, resource planning, and business cases.
Experience working with executive leadership to define strategy and drive organizational change.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Skills/Experience

Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud implementation and optimization experience.
Knowledge of pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, specialty pharmacy, or patient services ecosystems.
Experience with service management frameworks such as ITIL and operational excellence practices.
Experience with CRM modernization, customer engagement platforms, and omnichannel healthcare solutions.
Understanding of healthcare data, compliance, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Experience managing global delivery teams, consulting partners, and strategic vendors.
Salesforce certifications and advanced cloud platform expertise.
Master's degree in Business, Technology, Healthcare Administration, or related field.

Travel, Work Environment & Physical Requirements

Ability to travel up to 25% based on business needs.
Hybrid or remote work environment with periodic onsite leadership, planning, and stakeholder meetings.
Ability to perform standard office and computer-based work activities.

jobs.title: Head of Finance - Gaming Agency and Publisher
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a full time head of finance to help strengthen the financial foundation of VAL, which has been in operations for 10 years. This is an all remote role. Candidates must be located in Canada.

Candidates who do not have at least one of the following backgrounds - agency, gaming, or publishing experience will not be considered.

The Virtual Athletics League (VAL) is an both startup, leading agency in the VR space, and a publisher. We have the same network of investors who backed Tesla, Hotmail, and Skype.

We have worked directly with Meta on many supported projects including some of the most high profile in VR. Previously we have worked with Nerf, The Walking Dead, Metro, Alien, Hello Neighbor, and others like Gorilla Tag.

This is not a pure bookkeeping or controller role or day to day finance tasks.

Candidates who understand the modern challenges of gaming businesses and the VR industry are given the highest priority.

The ideal candidate has financial clarity, structure, and judgment while also helping mentor the team and experience in pricing and building robust invoice collection systems.

This is a leadership role. We are looking for those with a heart for team dynamics and growth.

The ideal person has experience in gaming agencies, service businesses project-based or retainer-based revenue environments companies. We are looking for someone with a keen eye for cash flow, forecasting, margins, and operational decision-making.

Core job duties

Building and improving core financial structures, reporting, and forecasting
Helping ensure the company has the right finance systems and rhythms in place
Advising on cash flow, budgeting, profitability, and planning
Bringing sharper visibility into margins, revenue quality, and financial decision-making
Supporting leadership with strategic financial thinking, not just historical reporting
Mentoring internal team members and helping improve finance-related accountability and maturity
Identifying gaps, weak spots, and opportunities in our current finance operations
Leadership coaching, hiring and other people management skills

What we’re looking for

Significant experience in at least some senior level financial position or even front line management role.
Strong command of financial planning, cash flow management, forecasting, and operational finance
Ability to work well in an entrepreneurial environment.
Someone practical, direct, and capable of building order without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
Forecasting experience and ability especially in agencies, gaming and live ops.

Pay is 110,000 CAD per year and starts on a four month initial contract with potential conversion to our EOR/Canadian legal entity.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice-President, Technology Lead, Health
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

The Opportunity

Lead a transformational technology organization powering health and benefits experiences for millions. As the Assistant Vice-President (AVP), Technology Lead
, you will own one of Sun Life Canada’s largest technology portfolios
for health benefits claims adjudication/processing, virtual health, and online pharmacy systems
.

You will lead a 250+ person technology professional organization
including 5 Directors across multiple high-performing squads in a matrixed environment. This is your chance to shape strategy, drive modernization, and build a world-class engineering culture that balances breakthrough innovation with operational excellence.

You'll partner with executives across Architecture, Product, Operations, and Business to define the future of Sun Life's health technology platforms including mission-critical mainframe systems to cutting-edge digital experiences—while managing complex vendor ecosystems and driving sustainable delivery practices.

This role is highly visible, mission-critical to Sun Life Canada’s core business, strategically influential, and demands a leader who thrives in complexity.

Why This Role Matters

You'll lead a strategic inflection point for Sun Life's health benefits claims and on-line health technology organization. Leading one of Sun Life Canada’s largest technology portfolios and 250+ technology professionals, you have the scale, resources, and mandate to drive meaningful modernization while serving millions of members. This is a high-visibility opportunity to influence enterprise technology strategy, build a best-in-class engineering culture, and deliver business impact in a complex, mission-critical environment.

What You'll Own

Technology Strategy & Modernization Leadership

Define and communicate a compelling technology vision that bridges near-term delivery with long-term platform modernization across health benefits claims, adjudication systems, online health platforms, and core systems of record.
Lead evolution of Sun Life's health technology ecosystem—making bold build vs. buy vs. partner decisions in an extremely large technology portfolio
Champion modern engineering practices, technology standards, and architectural excellence while actively managing technical debt in complex, non-greenfield environments
Partner with Business, Architecture, and Enterprise Technology leaders to design resilient, scalable platforms that deliver exceptional member and sponsor experiences

Delivery Excellence at Scale

Accountable for end-to-end delivery across multiple agile squads at varying maturity levels—driving velocity, quality, and reliability improvements
Manage relationships with system integrators and vendors, holding partners accountable for outcomes and knowledge transfer
Serve as the primary escalation point for critical platform and delivery issues in a mission-critical environment
Transform delivery metrics into actionable insights and drive continuous improvement

People Leadership & Culture Building

Lead, mentor, and develop 250+ technology professionals across 5 Director level reports and cross-functional teams
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, execution-focused culture rooted in psychological safety and continuous learning
Design high-performing team structures aligned with business outcomes and technical excellence
Build and retain technical talent through coaching, career development, and hands-on leadership

Financial & Strategic Vendor Management

Own platform budgeting, cost optimization, and capitalization decisions
Manage strategic vendor and SI relationships to maximize delivery quality and ROI
Drive alignment between IT spend and business value delivery

Governance & Risk Management

Establish governance that accelerates delivery while meeting regulatory and security requirements
Ensure platform stability, security, and effective incident/change management for mission-critical systems
Partner with Operations on disaster recovery and business continuity for enablement platforms

Who You Are

Experience & Expertise

10+ years in senior technology leadership roles for very large technology portfolios, with proven success delivering complex, mission-critical systems at enterprise scale
Track record modernizing and enabling technology platforms.
Experience working in a health benefits claims / health industry is good to have
Strong financial acumen—comfortable managing large budgets, vendor portfolios, and ROI optimization
Demonstrated ability to lead technology teams through transformation while maintaining operational excellence
Knowledge with Mainframe environments and their integration with modern and digital business-critical systems is good to have

Technical Credibility & Mindset

Strong technical foundation with the credibility to challenge architecture, delivery practices, CI/CD, and engineering approaches
Builder mentality—equally focused on fixing legacy systems, scaling capabilities, and enabling teams
Decisive leader comfortable making clear decisions amid ambiguity and complexity
Pragmatic, outcomes-driven thinker who balances innovation with stability
Collaborative leader who rebuilds trust, drives momentum, and fosters transparency

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (MBA or advanced degree is an asset)
Experience in regulated health, insurance or financial services is valuable

As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only as the position includes managing both French and English-speaking staff (Quebec and outside Quebec) and providing daily support to the team.

What’s in it for you?

Flexible hybrid work model.
Pension, stock and savings programs to help build and enhance your future financial security
Work and professional development that is united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives
A friendly, collaborative and inclusive culture
Be part of our continuous improvement journey in developing the next greatest digital enterprise experience.
Competitive salary and bonus structure influenced by market range data
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director, Management Equity Finance and Tax – SLC Management
jobs.description:
SLC Management is a growing global asset management firm providing innovative and diversified investment solutions to institutional investors. We are breaking new ground with a full spectrum of solutions for a growing institutional client base of more than 1400 organizations. Our history of organic and strategic growth reflects this commitment with over CA$422/US$304 billion in assets under management (AUM). As a subsidiary of Sun Life, we are aligned with one of the world’s leading financial services companies, and benefit from the stability and strength of that relationship.

We are a performance-driven organization with a deliberate focus on fostering a development-focused, inclusive culture revolving around our Core Values of being client obsessed
, valuing each other
, acting with speed
and having an owner’s mindset
. As part of our team, you play a role in fulfilling our purpose and making a difference. We offer a rewarding work environment that is filled with opportunity for growth where you will be empowered to meet the challenges of a highly competitive landscape.

Visit our website to learn more and for the most up to date AUM information.

SLC Management offers a mix of in-office and virtual work where our employees are empowered to do their best. Generally, employees are expected to work three or more days in-office each week with flexibility depending on their business, client and team needs.

Job Description:

Director, Management Equity Finance and Tax – SLC Management

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU:

As a Director, Management Equity Finance and Tax you will support the financial and tax operations of its Management Equity Plan (MEP). This role plays a critical part in ensuring accurate financial reporting, tax compliance, and stakeholder communication across SLC. The ideal candidate will support the development and implementation of robust reporting and communication processes, within tight deadlines, for the management equity plan at SLC Management. The role will ensure that management receive the information they need to complete their personal tax obligations arising from the MEP program and that the Sun Life group receives the information it needs for corporate tax purposes. As the MEP is complex, the role will require close collaboration with internal and external business partners to ensure the required information and filings are delivered in an efficient and well-controlled environment. An understanding of the different tax treatments for flow through entities (such as partnerships/LLCs), corporations and hybrid entities will be an advantage in being able to deliver in this role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Develop deep understanding of the drivers of income vs taxable income for individuals and corporates in the SLC group to support the MD in preparing MEP-related financial commentary based on taxable income and distributions across the US, Canada and RoW.
Analyze and reconcile accounting vs. taxable income differences and prepare simplified summaries for internal and external stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Advisory

Coordinate with internal and external tax advisors and operational tax teams to ensure timely and accurate tax filings and payments, on behalf of, or to individuals, including US state composite returns for Non-Residents, PTET elections.
Ensure information from SLC affiliates and corporate entities are properly accurate and complete to enable both corporate tax and personal tax reporting purposes.
Support the tax settlement process and partner with SLC and Corporate Treasury on the timing and amount of cash needs.

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a liaison between HR, Finance, Corporate Tax, Affiliate Tax, and external advisors to gather and disseminate financial and tax data.
Coordinate with affiliates, external tax advisors and SLF Corporate Tax team to understand the various data needs and develop a robust data repository to efficiently and effectively share information between parties.
Prepare quarterly tax analysis and commentary to support MEP participant communication, filings and payments on account.

Process Optimization

Contribute to the development and implementation of streamlined reporting and communication processes. Systems have already been selected and are being implemented, you must ensure systems generate synergies.
Identify opportunities to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of tax provision and settlement workflows.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED:

CPA or equivalent designation strongly preferred.
8+ years of experience in finance or tax roles, ideally within asset management or financial services and ideally with a strong tax component to their work
Strong curiosity, desire to learn and resilience - this is a multi-disciplinary role requiring understanding of finance, tax and legal structures across different jurisdictions (mainly US and Canada but also others, particularly the UK)
Experience working with tax-transparent entities and the tax reporting associated with them is a strong benefit
Strong understanding of tax-to-IFRS differences and legal entity structures
Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

The base salary range for this Director-level role is $110,000–$150,000 CAD.

The upper end of the posted range reflects compensation levels applicable to Senior Director roles.

Why SLC Management?

Opportunity to work for a growing global institutional asset manager
Excellent benefits and wellness programs to support the three pillars of your well-being – mental, physical and financial – including generous vacation and sick time, market-leading maternity, parental and adoption leave top up program, a partially-paid sabbatical program and much more
Pension, stock and savings programs with an employer-paid match to help build and enhance your future financial security
A flexible work environment with a friendly, caring, collaborative and inclusive culture focused on career growth development #WeWinAsATeam
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential
Award winning workplace culture - Great Place to Work® Certified in Canada and the U.S., “Best Places to Work” by Glassdoor, Award for Excellence for Mental Health at Work, “Best Places to Work in Money Management” by Pension & Investments

SLC Management is a regulated business, and this means that there are certain financial reporting and trading preclearance requirements for all employees. Successful candidates will be required to declare personal investment accounts and securities investments as well as seek preclearance on future transactions including those of household members.

Finance

110,000/110 000 - 180,000/180 000

Your actual base salary will be determined by your unique skills, qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a discretionary annual incentive award based on individual and overall business performance along with a broad range of competitive benefits.

We are dedicated to building teams with varied experiences, backgrounds perspectives and ideas that benefit our colleagues, clients, and the communities where we operate.
